label: French Cuff — 6 Buttonholes
description: This is a French cuff configured with six buttonholes, meaning each folded leaf carries extra holes so the cuff can be linked at multiple points or fitted to different wrist depths. The additional buttonholes allow the cuff to be cinched more precisely and give the closure a more engineered, bespoke appearance. Visually it remains a classic squared double cuff, but the extra perforations signal a more customized, tailored construction.
